reviews.title: Best app for sleep
reviews.contents: I’ve been using Slumber for about a year, and find it so good at quieting my mind for sleep. I find prefer the long stories for sleep. The only thing I would suggest to improve the app is to allow stories to be played consecutively, so you could string several of the shorter stories together.

reviews.title: slumber 5 star review
reviews.contents:
Slumber let’s me fall asleep within 10-20 minutes every night.
I’ve always had trouble sleeping and falling asleep and slumber fixed that in a week, i’m so happy I found slumber.
I’ve tried so many other sleeping apps and slumber was the only one that truly worked for me. Thank you slumber, your app is truly amazing!!

reviews.title: Scam!
reviews.contents: Do not download! They just charged me $50 for a one year subscription without my consent!!

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.contents: I like this app. I wanted to love it but it's not exactly what I wanted out of a sleep app. All the voices are lovely. The white noise options are good. I wish I could delete the stories that definitely don't work for me. I have a hard time staying relaxed & I wish there was a meditation that focused more on relaxing each body part with the breathing. Even groups of muscles. The stories don't seem to work for me. I like the meditations better but they get a little weird sometimes with things like Echoing. That stuff just wakes me right back up.

reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.contents:
This helps me and my child so much. THANK YYOOOOUUUU.

reviews.title: The best
reviews.contents: I have been listening to this everynight for over a year now , there are so many different stories and voices and I love it I wouldn’t be able to sleep without it

reviews.title: Slumber review
reviews.contents: I love it but there is like nothing I can listen to because you need to buy everything🤮😠 like can I just listen to people talking like mental health help should be free😭😡

reviews.title: No option to cancel free trial
reviews.contents: I clicked on free trial to see what that entailed. When I saw there was a charge I exited out however I have no idea if I’m going to be charged after the 7 days.  I just want to confirm I didn’t sign up for the free trial then get charged after 7 days. There is no option to request assistance.

reviews.title: Absolutely Amazing
reviews.contents: I have been searching for an app that has stories or meditations to help with sleep but also anxiety. This app is absolutely amazing. It has stories and meditations of different lengths. It has so many different types of stories that no matter what mood I’m in there is always something. I love it!! The narrators voices are superb as well!

reviews.title: SO EXPENSIVE
reviews.contents: This app used to be $49 FOR LIFETIME ACCESS now it’s almost $13 A MONTH!? I refuse to pay that
